items.question: How long does a typical renovation take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on the project scale, but we provide a strict schedule upfront and stick to it.

items.question: Do you handle the permits and planning?
items.answer: Yes, we manage all necessary permits and local approvals to ensure your project is compliant.

items.question: Will I have a dedicated project manager?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every project is assigned a manager who will be your main point of contact from start to finish.

items.question: Do you guarantee your finishing work?
items.answer: Yes, we stand behind the quality of our work and include a warranty on all finished spaces.
